items.justification: Statement 1 says the valid transitions are defined in src/domain/task-status.ts. That is true, but the table that defines them is at fixtures/task-api/src/domain/task-status.ts:13, and the statement cites only lines 25-27 and 29-31 (fixtures/task-api/src/domain/task-status.ts:26, fixtures/task-api/src/domain/task-status.ts:30). Those lines only look up TRANSITIONS and do not define it, so under the criterion the cited lines do not back the statement and it is unverifiable. Statements 2-4 are true (canTransition at fixtures/task-api/src/domain/task-status.ts:25, allowedTransitions at fixtures/task-api/src/domain/task-status.ts:29, the IllegalStatusTransitionError throw at fixtures/task-api/src/services/task.service.ts:50) and the answer is true, so one error among non-error statements gives partial.
